reviews.text:
I'm a regular customer.

I'm always so happy with how cute my dog ​​looks each time, and I love that they take photos and videos with a seasonal theme. They're great at taking pictures!

The grooming time is shorter compared to other places, which I think is less stressful for my dog.

I also appreciate being able to communicate via LINE!
The haircuts are always cute and the customer service is excellent.
They send lots of photos and videos, which makes me feel at ease leaving my belongings with them.

I've been going there for years! They always do a lovely job, and I always look forward to seeing the photos and videos! I can leave my dog ​​there with complete peace of mind! It's a grooming salon I'm extremely satisfied with.
I'm so happy you took such cute photos. I'm also very satisfied with the fluffy finish of the grooming. I'd love to request your services again!
I'm grateful that they can take care of my pet right away. It would be even better if the shampoo were cheaper.
